sn49.1-12:1.3: In brief, the four are the efforts to prevent, to abandon, to arouse, and to perfect.
sn49.1-12:1.5: According to the Sutta analysis at Vb 8, the “bad unskillful qualities” are greed, hate, and delusion with associated phenomena. “Enthusiasm” (chanda) is the wholesome and righteous desire to practice.
